clips.text: Welcome to W P P Production, Montevideo. Let’s meet the team on floor fourteen.
Welcome to WPP Production in Montevideo. We are arriving on floor fourteen. When the doors open, your presenter will be waiting to guide you through the office.
This is the office entrance. The door starts closed. Move closer, look at it, and press E, or use the button on screen, to open or close it.
This is our workspace. Facing workstations and meeting rooms connect the different areas of the team. I will stay beside you as you explore.
These are our meeting rooms. Glass fronts keep a visual connection with the office, with tables and equipment for teamwork.
This is the kitchen and the team gathering space. Take a moment to look around before continuing.
